name: 32619-singlestreamdecode-qwen38bfp8-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 5%, cooldown 5%, bounded at 240 requests with an 1800 s safety cap; streams=1 is declared, not a tuning seed.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, streaming on, prompt exactly 256 tokens and output exactly 512 (ignore_eos), n=1, no shared prefix, prefix caching off, sampling at engine defaults.
purpose: A streaming chat assistant for one user at a time, answering short prompts with long replies on a single GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-seqs: 2
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enforce-eager: false
